# Image { #anylumino.Image }

```python
Image(
    value='',
    format='png',
    width='',
    height='',
)
```

Image display widget.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type     | Description                                              | Default   |
|--------|----------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `''` |
| format | optional | Media format such as ``'png'``, ``'mp3'``, or ``'mp4'``. | `'png'` |
| width | optional | CSS width for media widgets. | `''` |
| height | optional | CSS height for media widgets. | `''` |
